# PixelMesh: AI Agent-First Image Tool Mesh & Cryptographic WebMCP Gateway
> Machine-Actionable Entry Point for Autonomous AI Agents and LLMs

## Overview
PixelMesh provides deterministic, sub-millisecond Sharp image processing tools via the Model Context Protocol (MCP JSON-RPC 2.0) and in-browser WebMCP (Chrome 149+ / navigator.modelContext).

## WebMCP In-Browser Protocol (OpenAI WebMCP Challenge)
- Studio URL: /studio
- Host Binding: document.modelContext and navigator.modelContext
- Registered Tools: 30+ tools directly exposed in browser for zero-key autonomous agent manipulation
- Core WebMCP Tools: crop_image, circle_crop, flip_image, rotate_image, straighten_photo, adjust_brightness, lighten_photo, darken_photo, adjust_exposure, adjust_contrast, adjust_gamma, grayscale_photo, color_photo_to_bw, make_sepia_tone, invert_image, shift_hue, adjust_saturation, adjust_vibrance, clip_photo, hsl_adjustment, sharpen_image, blur_image, noise_filter, posterize_photo, glow_effect, inspect_image, load_preset_image, set_comparison_slider, undo_canvas_action, export_canvas_image, build_filter_pipeline

## Autonomous Machine Onboarding (Backend MCP)
- Endpoint: POST /api/mcp
- Authentication: Asymmetric Cryptography (Ed25519 or RSA-2048)
- Header Requirements:
  - X-Agent-Key-Fingerprint: SHA256:<base64url-hash-of-public-key>
  - X-Agent-Timestamp: <unix-epoch-seconds>
  - X-Agent-Nonce: <unique-uuid>
  - X-Agent-Signature: <base64-signature-of-canonical-string>
- Canonical Formula: METHOD + "\n" + PATH + "\n" + TIMESTAMP + "\n" + NONCE + "\n" + SHA256_HEX(REQUEST_BODY)
- Initial Free Tier: 100 credits granted upon verified registration.
